disease.title: Disease Intelligence
disease.subtitle: AI-powered early detection, severity assessment, and outbreak alerts.
disease.uploadDesc: Upload a clear photo of diseased leaves, stems, or pods. Our AI will instantly identify the issue.
disease.scanningDesc: Running Deep Learning CNN models to identify diseases.
disease.urgentDesc: Current weather forecasts indicate prolonged high humidity (>85%) over the next 5 days. Without immediate fungicidal application, severity is predicted to reach 82% (Critical Stage).
disease.pathologyDesc: Early Leaf Spot (Cercospora arachidicola) appears as brown to reddish-brown circular spots surrounded by a yellow halo on the upper surface of the leaves. As identified by the CNN model, the lesions on your crop have reached 2-4mm in diameter, indicating an established secondary infection phase.
disease.rec1Desc: Apply a systemic fungicide (e.g., Chlorothalonil or Tebuconazole) immediately. Ensure complete foliar coverage, especially lower leaves.
disease.rec2Desc: Improve field drainage if possible. Avoid overhead irrigation during the late afternoon or evening to minimize leaf wetness duration.
disease.rec3Desc: Re-evaluate the crop in 7-10 days. Upload new images to track recovery or assess the need for a secondary application.
